_note: Machine-checkable form of the Deliverable Quality Bar in SKILL.md. Every per-pattern bar is a coverage count against the Dark Pattern Audit, so it is code; Jev judges only whether a root cause is upstream. Not machine-checked: "handles low-dark-pattern products without false positives" -- all three scenarios in evals/evals.json are riddled with dark patterns, so any check would pass vacuously; it needs a clean-product scenario. Conditional bars (copy rewrite, protective default) are scoped to the rows that trigger them.
